fallback.title: Single-family home
fallback.description: Roof-mounted system with self-consumption optimisation – properly sized rather than maximally sold.
deliverables: Shading analysis, system design and yield forecast
Modules, inverter, optional battery storage and EV charger
Pronovo EIV application, commissioning and safety certificate (SiNa)

fallback.title: Apartment building / ZEV
fallback.description: Self-consumption community (ZEV) – metering concept and tenant electricity planned in from the start.
deliverables: Metering concept and ZEV formation according to grid operator requirements
Coordination with the distribution grid operator and property management

fallback.title: Commercial & Agriculture
fallback.description: Large roof areas with high daytime consumption – designed around your load profile.
deliverables: Load profile analysis and indicative profitability calculation
Assessment of structural load, roof covering and fire protection
Monitoring and maintenance concept for ongoing operation
